proposed.choice: Retain command-specific public result and diagnostic adapters around the shared runtime.
proposed.rationale: SR-040, SR-046, and SR-047 preserve independently versioned results and require diagnostics to remain semantically independent.
alternatives: A universal result/logging wrapper would need an explicit compatibility redesign because recording and generic commands have different admission and output contracts.
consequences: Keep recording exclusions and pre-publication receipt preparation explicit. Installation dispatch still needs its IR-010 analysis.
revisit_when: A separately approved public-contract migration reconciles all affected command domains.
